text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the hallway……

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Out of the way! Coming through!

A student went sliding down the staircase 
handrail at breakneck speed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, huh!? She's not here! Whyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm chasing after it at full 
throttle, I keep losing sight of it!
choice_data_list:
How about trying to predict your 
opponent's moves?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Handrail... a shortcut...? I see, she 
jumped right over the handrail!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What a brilliant strategy! Thank you, you 
really saved me!

Fired up to the max, Winning Ticket dashed 
away.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Predictions? A forecast, a forecast... Ah! 
That's it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the other side is 
front-running at full throttle too! Then 
I'll just have to go waaaay more all-out!

Fired up to the max, Winning Ticket dashed 
away.
